chunks: His heart did not falsify what he perceived.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'His heart did not falsify' mean in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the infallibility (Ismah) of the Prophet's heart during the reception of revelation, distinguishing his spiritual vision from mere imagination. It underscores the reliability of the Prophet's testimony as the primary source of Islamic law, affirming that his inner perception of the Divine reality was pure and undistorted by ego or error.
